purpose: Produce a panel-free, identity-free integrity and handoff audit over the already published D1-D5 descriptive evidence without adding a study verdict.
accessOrder: freeze this audit contract and all source-file hashes
run the synthetic fixture self-test and deliberate sabotage
read only the committed D1-D5 preregistrations, scripts, JSON artifacts, and reports
verify the sealed cadence script hash without executing a panel run
recompute headline arithmetic and cross-study consistency flags
write the identity-free D6 JSON audit
render the D6 handoff report only from that audit
forbiddenInputs: No SQLite panel, encrypted file, outcome file, price file, signal row, or company-level record may be opened by D6.
auditStatistic: number of source-hash, report-contract, arithmetic, anchor, scope, or cross-study reconciliation failures
nullModel: zero integrity failures in the published D1-D5 descriptive package
threshold: one or more failures makes the D6 handoff audit fail closed
interpretationPolicy: D6 may expose numeric agreements, disagreements, and unanswered review questions but may not choose a study verdict, modify a threshold, or promote a method.
effectiveN: D6 adds no empirical observations. Every effective N remains the one declared in its source artifact.
requiredOutputs: byte hashes for every bound source
explicit list of remaining judgment questions owned by Claude
zero company identifiers and zero new panel observations
explicitNonClaims: D6 is not a new empirical analysis or preregistered hypothesis test.
A clean audit does not make any descriptive association causal.
A clean audit does not change the completed confirmatory verdict.
Only Claude may decide whether the descriptive study is methodologically complete.
